text:
eng-oncall-bot: ALERT: cont-batcher | error_rate increased >5% for backend pool us-east-1, KV eviction storm detected (auto-pager triggered).

Priya (oncall): I'm on it. seeing elevated tail latency and gRPC errors on the cont-batcher pool. pausing any non-critical deploys.

Jamal (runtime): looking at runtime metrics now — eviction_count spiked across multiple shards, and continuous-batch queue latency jumped. suspected config drift from last night's rollout.

Alice (sre): can you paste the config that rolled out? thinking max_batch_tokens or max_num_seqs got bumped too high and we've saturated KV memory leading to paging.

Jamal (runtime): config from canary as of 23:40 UTC:
```
max_batch_tokens: 4096
max_num_seqs: 48
timeout_ms: 1500
kv_cache_size_mb: 512
kv_prefetcher: enabled
```

Jamal (runtime): metrics snapshot:
```
evictions_total: 3248
p99_latency_ms: 910
error_rate: 7.2%
active_batches: 12k
kv_mem_pressure: 93%
```

Priya (oncall): ok, immediate mitigation idea: 1) reduce max_batch_tokens to 1024 2) reduce max_num_seqs to 16 3) enable rampdown circuit-breaker to prevent new large batches 4) enable aggressive KV eviction policy temporarily.

Sophie (support): any customer-facing impact here? I'm seeing elevated 5xx for some customer routes in US-EAST. Tickets incoming from Acme and Queryly.

Priya (oncall): estimated affected customers: acme-corp, queryly, file-parse-svc. errors are mostly 502/504 timeouts, not data corruption.

Jamal (runtime): applying quick config patch to the config service now (will patch only cont-batcher route flags).

Priya (oncall): paste the patch command you run so I can follow.

Jamal (runtime): running:
```
curl -s -X PATCH https://internal-config.redwood/api/v1/services/cont-batcher \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"max_batch_tokens":1024,"max_num_seqs":16,"timeout_ms":800,"kv_eviction_mode":"aggressive","enable_rampdown_cb":true}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued -> patch-config-service (patch-id: cfg-24123). Rolling out to us-east-1 (canary 10%).

Jamal (runtime): canary metrics after 30s: p99 down 40%, evictions down 70% on canary shard. error_rate for canary down to 1.1%.

Priya (oncall): good sign. rolling to 50% now.

ops-bot: config patch applied to 50% nodes in us-east-1. No pod restarts required.

Sophie (support): confirming with customer reports — Acme's volume of 5xx dropped after ~90s of the patch. sending status update to impacted accounts.

Marco (next-oncall): I'm taking the handoff in 20 mins. any follow-ups I should own?

Priya (oncall): main follow-ups: 1) investigate why the canary config ended up with 4096/48 (audit config change history) 2) add an automated guard on max_batch_tokens vs kv_cache_size_mb to block unsafe combos 3) postmortem + customer RCA 4) run load test to reproduce. I'll stay for the handoff.

Alice (sre): adding temporary alert rule: if kv_mem_pressure > 85% AND active_batches > 10k -> trigger immediate autoscale down of batch size and notify paging team.

Jamal (runtime): started an adhoc test to reproduce with reduced KV size to ensure the new limits won't under-provision. sharing logs: https://internal-logs/cont-batcher/2412345678

Priya (oncall): escalation level set to Sev2 due to multiple paying customers affected, but customer requests are recovering. logging incident channel and will draft customer-safe post.

Sophie (support): posted support note to affected customers: "We've mitigated a performance regression related to batch sizing. You may have seen transient 5xx; no data loss. We'll follow up with RCA."

Priya (oncall): handing over to Marco in 20. Marco, if things re-regress, your immediate playbook: 1) toggle cont-batcher -> enable_rampdown_cb = true 2) set max_batch_tokens=512 3) temporarily route heavy tenants to fallback model pool (route tag: low-memory).

Marco (next-oncall): acknowledged. I'll monitor for 2hrs and then follow up with infra to schedule the config guard.

Priya (oncall): closing immediate remediation window. final numbers: evictions reduced from ~3248 -> ~220 in 5m for full rollout, p99 latency down from 910ms -> 180ms, error_rate from 7.2% -> 0.9% in affected region.

Jamal (runtime): creating a follow-up PR to add a unit test that verifies batch config doesn't allow (max_batch_tokens * expected_seq_token_cost) > kv_cache_size_mb * 1024 / token_byte_size.

Alice (sre): scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Priya, assign owners for the checklist items in the doc.

Priya (oncall): will do. Elemental cause: mis-tuned batch limits plus a canary gap that didn't exercise high concurrency. We'll add a canary load profile and the config guard.

Sophie (support): customers notified. Marking support ticket thread: SR-8791, SR-8792 as "mitigated" for now.

eng-oncall-bot: Handoff note recorded. Next oncall: Marco (starts 20m).

Marco (next-oncall): taking over. thanks team. :thumbsup:

Priya (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll update the incident doc with the timeline and actions.

(END)
